toigo_female_double-breasted_suit.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_female_double-breasted_suit.description: This is a women's double-breasted suit that will fit female and mostly female humans. Some adjustments maybe needed for child senior and plus size humans. I have included diffuse specular and normal maps and the .mhmat file should get them all imported into Blender where their properties can be adjusted according to preference and render engine. This suit uses the same UV mapping as my Mens' Double-breasted Suit http://www.makehumancommunity.org/clothes/mens_doublebreasted_suit.html . Illustration shows suit with subsurf of two and some slight adjustments were made to fit the pants over the shoes. Nicole is also wearing my Women's Loafers http://www.makehumancommunity.org/clothes/womens_loafers.html .

toigo_female_suit.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_female_suit.description: This is a suit for female humans of almost every body type. Diffuse bump and specular maps are included.

toigo_female_suit_2.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_female_suit_2.description: This is a suit for female humans. It will fit most ages and body types but adjustments will been needed for child senior and plus-size humans. This suit uses the same UV mapping as my Men's Suit 3 http://www.makehumancommunity.org/clothes/mens_suit_3.html . I have included diffuse specular and normal maps and the .mhmat file should get them all imported into Blender where their properties can be adjusted according to preference and render engine. Illustration shows suit with subsurf of two and some slight adjustments were made to the jacket around the crotch area. Nicole is also wearing my Ankle Boots http://www.makehumancommunity.org/clothes/ankle_boots.html .

toigo_male_double-breasted_suit.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_male_double-breasted_suit.description: This is a men's double-breasted suit that will fit male and mostly male humans. Some adjustments maybe needed for child senior and big and tall humans. I have included diffuse specular and normal maps and the .mhmat file should get them all imported into Blender where their properties can be adjusted according to preference and render engine. Illustration shows suit with subsurf of two. Owen is also wearing my Men's Loafers http://www.makehumancommunity.org/clothes/mens_loafers.html .

toigo_male_suit_3.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_male_suit_3.description: This is a men's suit with more details than my previous suits. It will fit male and mostly male humans but some adjustments may be needed for child senior and big and tall humans. I have included diffuse specular and normal maps and the .mhmat file should get them all imported into Blender where their properties can be adjusted according to preference and render engine. Illustration shows suit with subsurf of two and some slight adjustments were made to the shirt collar around the neck. Chance is also wearing my Men's Loafers http://www.makehumancommunity.org/clothes/mens_loafers.html .

toigo_male_suit_tie_and_jacket.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_male_suit_tie_and_jacket.description: This is a men's suit with a close to universal fit for most male humans. I have included bump and specular maps. Illustration models are also wearing Shoes Oxford male by Mindfront.

toigo_suit_with_dinner_jacket.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_suit_with_dinner_jacket.description: This is a men's suit with a dinner jacket that will fit male and mostly male humans. Some adjustments maybe needed for child senior and big and tall humans. I have included diffuse specular and normal maps and the .mhmat file should get them all imported into Blender where their properties can be adjusted according to preference and render engine. Illustration shows suit with subsurf of two and a procedural gold texture was assigned to the trim on the buttons. Owen is also wearing my Ankle Boots Male http://www.makehumancommunity.org/clothes/ankle_boots_male.html in Black http://www.makehumancommunity.org/content/ankle_boots_male_black.html .

toigo_suit_with_jacket_and_bowtie.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_suit_with_jacket_and_bowtie.description: This is a suit with a jacket and bowtie. Bump and spec maps are included. Three alternate colors are available in Materials. Illustration models are also wearing Shoes Oxford Male by Mindfront.
